adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` change the fallback from the previous `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` (single object) to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else-branch condition), this `find` searches for a calendar whose `externalId` equals that falsy value, which will generally never match, yielding `undefined`. In `deleteEvent`, that `undefined` is then used as `calendarId` for `calendar.events.delete(...)` (no fallback to `primary`), which can break deletion when a booking reference lacks `externalCalendarId`.
